summary: Master advanced machine learning, XGBoost, and MLOps. Build production-grade predictive models and explainable AI systems. Enroll for expert-led training.
lede: Advanced machine learning training helps data analysts, data scientists, risk analysts, and technical managers develop and validate predictive models from structured data. It covers profiling data, engineering features, and building reproducible workflows with model evaluation and tuning for classification and regression. Learners also practise interpreting predictions, checking for drift, and communicating model limitations for operational handover.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with structured data, reporting, analytics, or technical decision support and now need a more rigorous machine learning workflow. It suits intermediate practitioners who can interpret data tables and basic statistical outputs but want guided practice with model development, validation, explainability, and operational handover.
modules: Machine Learning Foundations and Problem Framing
prerequisites: Working knowledge of spreadsheets, structured datasets, and basic descriptive statistics is required. Familiarity with Python syntax is recommended, but advanced programming experience is not required. Coding is required for guided notebook exercises, with templates and prepared datasets supplied. Advanced neural networks, MLOps, and deployment architecture are covered at operational application level rather than technical engineering depth. You will need a laptop with access to a Python environment such as Anaconda or a comparable Jupyter setup.
topics: Data science & machine learning in practice
